about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples: row 501 item H / card t_e82c2951, the 60% usage parker. `tests.gauntlet.agent_budget.check_usage_budget` reads capsule-corp's usage-window.json (utilization, reset_at, written_at) and must raise `gauntlet.adapter.Park` once utilization is at or over the 60% threshold with a fresh (<=900s old) reading, carrying `until=reset_at` so the runner's --wait-on-park resumes after the reset; a reading below threshold, or one with no fresh source (missing or stale file), must never park. Run by tests/intent/test_usage_meter_park_intent.py against tests.gauntlet.agent_budget.check_usage_budget + usage_fraction, through a real usage-window.json file (never the USAGE_ENV stub, so staleness is exercised for real). Two oracles per example: whether Park was raised at all, and (when it was) that `until` equals the window's own `reset_at` -- a park with the wrong or missing resume time is as wrong as no park.
subject: tests/gauntlet/agent_budget.py:check_usage_budget + usage_fraction

examples.source: Pratik's ruling (row 501 item H): park at 60%, resume after the reset
